summary.text: Gary Hicks is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 9 who has served since January 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gary Hicks assumed office representing Tennessee House District 9 on January 12, 2016.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Finance, Ways, and Means, Health and Insurance committees, among others.
